newsitem.title: USA: Paine Webber Q3 recurring fees, margins up.
newsitem.headline: Paine Webber Q3 recurring fees, margins up.

text.p: Paine Webber Group Inc said on Tuesday its recurring fees reached an all-time high of $560 million annualized.
The company also said its pre-tax margins improved to 14 percent, compared to 12.8 percent for the same quarter last year.

"We are pleased with our third quarter earnings, which surpassed the consensus estimates and represent consistent improvement despite uncertain markets in the quarter," said PaineWebber Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Donald Marron. The company reported fully diluted third quarter 1996 earnings of $0.75 per share against $0.67 per share in the same quarter last year.
PaineWebber said the value of assets under control increased during the quarter to a record $234.1 billion.
